log: `moved/move-cargo` sent every unit in the manifest along with the transport's move. `Unload` in port only wakes the cargo, so a unit woken there and fortified as the city's garrison stayed aboard and sailed off (civ-clone/web-renderer#553).

When the move starts in one of the transport's player's cities, cargo that is `Stowed` or `Sleeping` (Civ1's Sentry, as `moved/collect-sleeping` reads it) goes along; the rest is unloaded and stays in the city. At sea all of the cargo still goes with it.

An aircraft aboard has no orders but to take off, which leaves the Carrier (`moved/take-off`), and simple-ai-client wakes the aircraft aboard its carriers each turn. Leaving them in port left an AI Carrier's air group behind (civ-clone/web-renderer#553).
